description: Database client and SQL studio for Orca with an opt-in AI SQL Assistant (inline ghost completion, real-time SQL syntax diagnostics, Fix with AI, and EXPLAIN plan analyzer). Browse schemas, edit and import data, design tables, and run SQL, MQL, or Redis queries over SSH and TLS across 12 built-in engines (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, CockroachDB, ClickHouse, Redis, LibSQL/Turso, Cloudflare D1, MSSQL, Oracle, MongoDB) plus 7 local BYOD drivers.

settings.title: Max Rows Ceiling
settings.description: Maximum number of rows returned by a query

settings.title: Query Timeout (seconds)
settings.description: Maximum execution time before cancelling a query

settings.title: AI SQL Assistant
settings.description: Enable AI inline SQL autocomplete (ghost text) and EXPLAIN plan analysis. When off, only local schema and keyword completion runs.

settings.title: AI Provider Format
settings.description: API protocol used by the configured AI provider.

settings.title: AI Base URL
settings.description: Root URL of your chosen AI provider.

settings.title: AI Model
settings.description: Fast model for inline SQL completion and EXPLAIN analysis.

settings.title: AI Max Completion Tokens
settings.description: Maximum tokens requested for each inline SQL suggestion.

settings.title: AI EXPLAIN Max Tokens
settings.description: Maximum tokens for AI EXPLAIN analysis responses (higher values prevent truncation in Vietnamese/CJK).

settings.title: EXPLAIN Analysis Language
settings.description: Language used by AI when explaining execution plans and bottlenecks. SQL and DDL stay in standard SQL.
